text:
sophia-hr: FYI Ana Morales got a 1095-C stating 'No coverage offered' for 2025. She was on Redwood private payroll and had company coverage. Can payroll ops look?

ana-morales: I switched from contractor -> W2 on 2025-04-15 and had benefits effective 05/01. I attached screenshot in DM but flag looks wrong.

james-payroll: @sophia-hr thanks. Was she processed as contractor for any payroll system in Q1? If yes, our benefits vendor won't create an employer-covered 1095c. :thinking:

sophia-hr: She was onboarded as 'contractor' in Greenhouse then converted; payroll run for Apr had a special code 'CONV-APR' — not sure if that maps to benefits feed. Antonio, any idea from finance side?

antonio-finance: Looking. Our benefits enrollment feed to BeneCorp includes only records with benefits_code != 'NONE'. For conversions we rely on oss_enroll flag set after final payroll. If conversion processed after cut-off, 1095C could show 1H/no.

james-payroll: Can you paste the 1095C line? Need to see offer/coverage code 1A/1H etc.

sophia-hr: pasted below (redacted):
```
Employee: Ana Morales
TIN: ***-**-1234
Line 14: 1H
Line 16: 2C
```
(weird mix)

antonio-finance: 1H = no offer, 2C = enrolled. That mismatch happens when monthly feeds had employer not-offered but mid-month enrollment created. Need to reconcile month-level records.

james-payroll: Quick fix: we'll open a wage-history reconciliation for Apr-May and submit an adjusted 1095C request to BeneCorp. ETA 3 business days. Ana, you won't need to file anything now but expect a corrected form.

ana-morales: Thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. Also, can you confirm whether this affects my state tax withholding for NY/UK split?

sophia-hr: Good question — separate. Antonio, can you confirm whether any payroll withholding reclassification is required for the midyear conversion (NY resident to UK remote for Q2)?

antonio-finance: That is a separate review — initial read: earnings split already flagged in payroll codes (UK-taxed portion in payroll run 05). If there's a misclassification we'll do a retro adjustment. I'll follow up in DM with specifics.

james-payroll: I'll attach the reconciliation ticket number once created. @sophia-hr please tell Ana I'll follow up by EOD.

sophia-hr: thanks team :raised_hands:

hr-bot: Created ticket PPL-7893 for 1095-C correction, assigned to james-payroll. Reminder: deadline for corrected 1095-C filings is Mar 31.
